scope: 40 fixed original fold0 training images; no hardness labels, holdout/test, model fitting, upload or external data. Synthetic fixtures only algorithm checks.
selection: Sorted original development fold!=0 IDs, numpy default_rng choice40 without replacement; no label file opened.
hypothesis: Joint piecewise-constant latent region field + sparse dark layer, bounded isotropic Gaussian blur, affine contrast/offset and bounded separable AR1 residual likelihood may separate imaging nuisance from morphology better than sequential TV watershed.
model: Own approximate continuous Potts-like log-gradient prior, not a reproduction of either referenced paper, not a known competition generator. Two blur initializations,100 fixed Adam steps, summarize median; no objective-based start selection.
nonidentifiability: Unknown regions/blur/contrast/noise trade off; constraints and two starts do not identify true generator. Grain/phase/pore/alignment are proxies. Isotropic blur and separable Gaussian AR noise may be wrong.

duplicate_audit.denoised_grain_features.py: TV .5/1 noise followed by gradient watershed; no joint rendering likelihood
duplicate_audit.strong_denoised_grain_features.py: Same denoise with larger marker prominence
duplicate_audit.connected_grain_features.py: TV + local dark ridge + closing/connected complement
duplicate_audit.autocov_shape_features.py: Nonzero-lag covariance and separate noise indicators; no inverse model
duplicate_audit.simple_noise_variance_subtraction: Excluded; previous audit found harmful shortcut

nuisance_calibration: Same40 train images only: robust HH noise, q98-q2 contrast; blur indicator gradient-energy ratio sigma1/sigma0. No claim identifies true blur. Fixed perturbations: affine span0.9 +offset0.05; extra blur0.5px; Gaussian-correlated noise sigma0.5px with std=.5*image HH noise. Record train quantiles and added-noise bounds. These are mild synthetic probes, not estimated true generator distribution.

stability_gate.definition: Per descriptor median over40 images of RMS difference over3 perturbations vs identity, normalized by baseline identity cross-image IQR; candidate/baseline ratio<=.70 for all4. Nearzero baseline sensitivity has no evidence of30% improvement and fails.

preservation_gate.degenerate_definition: latent std<.02 OR noise near upperbound>1.95*n0 OR blur>1.72 OR boundary fraction<.002 OR >.35
preservation_gate.no_anchor_policy: Empty anchors uninformative, never scored perfect; require>=10 images with pore anchors and >=30 with boundary anchors.

fixtures: Three analytic non-Voronoi rectangular/elongated/wavy region layouts at256px, alternating intensity phases, known thin1px boundaries and disk radius3/5/7 isolated+attached pores; two fixed noise/blur severities. Deterministic fixtures are not training data.
failure_policy: Any gate failure rejects this family without residual regression, CV, parameter tuning or candidate creation. Only all-gates pass permits separately implemented inner-crossfit residual study.
